sql: SELECT LAND1, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM KNA1 GROUP BY LAND1 ORDER BY customers DESC
SELECT k.NAME1, SUM(b.DMBTR) FROM BSID b JOIN KNA1 k ON lpad(b.KUNNR, 10, '0') = k.KUNNR GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
WITH totals AS (SELECT KUNNR, SUM(DMBTR) AS t FROM BSID GROUP BY 1) SELECT AVG(t) FROM totals
SELECT strftime(ZFBDT, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) FROM BSID GROUP BY 1
SELECT NAME1 FROM KNA1 WHERE NAME1 LIKE '%Supply%' AND LAND1 IN ('DE', 'FR')
SELECT KUNNR, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY KUNNR) FROM KNA1
SELECT aging_bucket, ROUND(SUM(DMBTR), 2) FROM model.v_bsid GROUP BY aging_bucket
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT KUNNR) FILTER (WHERE DMBTR > 1000) FROM BSID
